- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Open design Q2 (issue #4867) — on a missing fresh CI run after a CI-fix push, auto-re-trigger CI or fail loudly to a stall?
  **A**: Fail loudly to a recoverable stall. Reuse the existing `NO_CHECKS` → STALLED bail by passing a bounded `empty_checks_grace` on the post-push monitor re-entry. Auto-re-trigger (empty commit / close-reopen) pollutes history or has PR side effects; the issue explicitly accepts "fail loudly with a stall/operator signal". Operator re-triggers/merges manually.
- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Open design Q3 (issue #4867) — run the harness partition guard relevant-check for every `python/test_*.py` change or only ENFORCED-set files?
  **A**: ENFORCED-set files only, read from `scripts/lint-harness-pytest-partition.py` via `ast` (single source of truth). Bounds added local-check cost; the guard only enforces strict partition on its ENFORCED tuple, so non-ENFORCED test files cannot trip it.
